title: susi workflow check: tell an agent up front whether it may start work
goal: New 'susi workflow check [--json]': is this checkout the agent's own worktree (not the primary checkout, not main, not detached); is it up to date with origin/main (fetch first; behind count); are the hooks installed (core.hooksPath resolves to this worktree's .githooks and commit-msg/pre-commit/pre-push/workflow-guard exist and are executable); does the agent hold a live claim. Print a checklist with the exact fix command for each failure, exit 1 on any failure (offline fetch/claims are warnings). Pure evaluation in susi-gawd admin::workflow, real-git integration tests in tests/workflow_check.rs.
